reviews.x: It’s not waterproof as it claims.  It’s not a thick formula and requires a few coats to even see that you have mascara on.  Imagine a watered down mascara…..this I what you’ll get.  The 2 for the price of 1 enticed me.  Don’t fall for it!
My lashes have always been long and curved but this mascara, makes them look longer! Also, didn’t read the description but they came 2 in the package for a great price!

I changed my review from 2 stars to 5. I only think it was fair to give this mascara a chance and I'm glad I did. I like that it doesn't irritate my eyes and lasts all day, it moisturizing to my lashes ( a huge plus!) and it's easy to remove. I apply 2 to 3 coats and it makes my eyes pop! It doesn't hold the curl as well but it's good enough!

I have very straight hair and eyelashes and was somewhat skeptical as to the curling effect of this mascara, but low and behold, I don't even need to use my eyelash curler with it.  It curls, lengthens and stays - no smudging or smearing even after on of my 5:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. days.  Great value!

This is an amazing mascara! I finally found one that doesn’t clump, separates my lashes and makes them appear longer. I just soap and water and removes easily.  I had seen a FB ad about this product and began reading the reviews and saw some say Amazon has it at a fraction of the price.

I don't know about "sky high" and "buildable", may take lots of applications. But, goes on nicely, doesn't clump. Stays on, no raccoon eyes. Washes off well - more sheds off than dissolves off, so still no raccoon eyes.

I use the mascara on my natural eyelashes. My lashes are a little long but I use it to bring out the volume. It's fairly good and it's easy to get off. I've cried with the mascara on and it drained off. It's alright.
This product didn't fulfill any claims. It smeared quickly. It barely even looked like I put it on.. false claims. Not waterproof,flaked off

reviews.t: It gave me an eye infection
reviews.x: First time of using I got a eye infection. It didn't give my lashes the fullness I was hoping for either. I had to throw it away.

reviews.t: Nice but doesn't do what it says
reviews.x: It is a nice mascara but it doesn't make your eyelashes long like it says it does.
I saw this on some TikTok video. I bought for wife.. she instantly loved them.
The mascara looks great, but it is not waterproof at all.

reviews.t: lasts all day, removes easily, actually lengthens, doesnt irritate my eyes, budget friendly option
reviews.x: When the times comes to wash my face, this mascara comes off extra easy. I didnt realize how much other mascaras left behind, once I did my usual face wash (oil cleanse to start, then follow up with water based), and the mascara began to break down right away. Very pleased with that.  This SkyHigh mascara is actually lengthening. I have basic lashes, and I dont expect anything magical from mascara. But this is noticeable on my lashes, and as I was swiping it on I could see the lashes looking elo

The first time I ordered this mascara it was awesome and definitely was lash lengthening. The second time, both containers were blobby and runny and messy, it was like a different product. Thought this was maybe a one off, so I ordered again and this time it was pathetic and dry. The formula seems to be all over the place. Ordered 3 times and each time it was drastically different. I don't recommend. Went back to L'oreal Luminous.

This mascaras is worth the price, a set of two for under 10? Go for it. It's not overly sticky, though the consistency is weird and rubbery coming out of the tube. It goes on dark, dries quickly and doesn't smudge. Does it really lengthen? Eh. Not really for me. But, it's not messy or flaky. I don't know if I will repurchase, but the price point is good.

The brush is thick, a but of a learning curve to not get product on my lids.  The product itself is not thick enough for me.  I found myself having to go over and over to make my lashes seem thick.  I think I'll be sticking to my regular sky high maybelline product that I only need 3 to 4 swipes to get the product on.

This is a nice mascara and you are getting two different tubes.  It is a black which I like.  It applies easily with no clumping or flaking.  It did not irritate my eyes either which is nice as some make me rub my eyes all day long.  They did lengthen more than making them fuller.  Overall, a nice mascara.

reviews.t: If it looking for water proof this isn't it.
reviews.x: I got this because everybody was talking about how good it was. This is a good mascara you do have to put layers on, but if you're like me, I have very watery eyes so I need waterproof. I ordered waterproof and it says waterproof but it isn't it , I had mascara all over my face.

These are really nice mascaras. They go on easily and provide nice coverage. Since they are waterproof, I was concerned that it might be difficult to wash off, but it has come off without an issue. For this price, this is definitely a good mascara option.

I almost don’t want to rave about this mascara because I don’t want it to sell out or get more expensive! I love it!! It dries quick and my eyelashes stay long and curled!! I can’t believe I got 2 for $8.00!! My favorite mascara now!!

reviews.t: I've used knockoffs from ebay that worked much better!
reviews.x: I don't feel like this purchase was a total waste but, the mascara quality and lengthening could stand some work! As stated, I've brought a knockoff no name from ebay that did the job for much less money and less applications!

I received 2 and the first one I opens something Broke inside so the mascara came out in a huge clump on the applicator. Some sort of squeegee thing inside the tube came loose. Other 1 works fine but it’s very flaky mascara

You have to add like 10 layers to even look like you have anything on, the brush doesn’t even look like the one pictured. I was enticed by the 2 for 1 deal and saw this on FB, lol don’t fall for this one!!

claims.text: Many reviewers say it lengthens lashes and makes eyes pop, though a few say it doesn't lengthen as claimed.
Several reviewers report it is not waterproof and smears or flakes, contradicting the product's claims.
Reviewers commonly praise easy removal and all-day wear without irritation or smudging.
The two-for-one value and low price are frequently highlighted as a plus.
A few reviewers report clumping, runny or dry inconsistent formula, and even an eye infection.
